items.caption: A modern vector rendering of 三 in Shuowen seal-script style. Its three horizontal strokes illustrate a later script style; they are not an excavated inscription.
items.alt: Three horizontal strokes in a seal-script style, with the middle stroke longest.
items.selection_reason: The rendering is identified as 三 in seal-script style and its visible three-stroke form is clear. It illustrates a later script style, while the counting-rod interpretation remains a separate explanation and the image does not verify Shang or Western Zhou artifact forms.

limitations.text: No selected image shows the cited Shang oracle-bone examples or the Western Zhou bronze record, so the early numeral attestations and their proposed counting-rod interpretation cannot be visually checked against those artifacts here.
